

```{r}
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)

pop_file <- "~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/data/WorldPop/LVB_WorldPop_2000_2020.tif"
out_dir <- "~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/output/population_pressure"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pop <- rast(pop_file)
years <- 2000:2020
names(pop) <- paste0("Population_", years)
```

```{r}
# Basin-wide population change

pop_total <- global(pop, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[, 1]
pop_ts <- data.frame(year = years, population = pop_total)

ggplot(pop_ts, aes(year, population)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Estimated population") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Population distribution at the beginning and end of the period

plot(c(pop[[1]], pop[[21]]))
```

```{r}
# Convert population counts to density

cell_area_km2 <- cellSize(pop[[1]], unit = "km")
pop_density <- pop / cell_area_km2
names(pop_density) <- paste0("Population_density_", years)

# Keep the known zero-population patch as zero in 2012
pop_density[[13]] <- ifel(is.na(pop_density[[13]]) & pop_density[[12]] == 0 & pop_density[[14]] == 0, 0, pop_density[[13]])
```

```{r}
# Change between 2000 and 2020

density_change <- pop_density[[21]] - pop_density[[1]]
names(density_change) <- "Population_density_change_2000_2020"

plot(density_change)
```

```{r}
# Annual population density trend

density_slope_fun <- function(x) {
  ok <- !is.na(x)
  if (sum(ok) < 15) return(NA)
  coef(lm(x[ok] ~ years[ok]))[2]
}

density_slope <- app(pop_density, density_slope_fun)
names(density_slope) <- "Population_density_slope_2000_2020"

plot(density_slope)
```

```{r}
# Direction of population density trends

v <- values(density_slope, mat = FALSE)
v <- v[!is.na(v)]

density_summary <- data.frame(
  class = c("Decrease", "No change", "Increase"),
  cells = c(sum(v < 0), sum(v == 0), sum(v > 0))
)

density_summary$percent <- 100 * density_summary$cells / sum(density_summary$cells)

density_summary
```

```{r}
writeRaster(density_change, file.path(out_dir, "population_density_change_2000_2020.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
writeRaster(density_slope, file.path(out_dir, "population_density_annual_slope_2000_2020.tif"), overwrite = TRUE)
```
